cases.name: Snezana "Suzie" Trifunovski
cases.about: She spent much of her career in the healthcare industry and was a longtime employee at Syracuse Home, a nursing home and rehabilitation center in Baldwinsville. "Suzie was a devoted, dependable and dedicated caregiver at Syracuse Home for the past 22 years," her employer said in a statement. "She was a kind, caring, compassionate spirit who will be deeply missed by both the residents and her Syracuse Home family." Anne Doss said she worked with Suzie at St. Camillus, a nursing home and rehab facility in Geddes, in the 1990s. Both women were certified nursing assistants. "I was saddened to hear of her passing," Doss said. "She was beautiful, funny and caring."
cases.narrative: He beat her to death with his hands & a wooden object and suffocated her with a pile of clothing then hid her body in a storage unit.

cases.name: Ava Wood
cases.about: She was a 9th grader at Durgee Junior High School, was an excellent student and played soccer and track and field.
cases.narrative: On 1/20/2023, she was discovered, deceased from a shotgun wound to the head, during a welfare check requested by her mother when she did not show up for school.
